build_phi4mm_image_encoder: build a Phi4MMImageEncoder to process images and return vision embeddings for multimodal input
create_phi4mm_for_causal_lm: create a Phi4MMForCausalLM model combining a Llama language model with vision and audio encoders
run_phi4mm_forward: run the Phi4MMForCausalLM forward pass with input_ids, positions, and a ForwardBatch for multimodal generation
get_image_feature: get image features from a list of MultimodalDataItem objects using the vision encoder
load_phi4mm_weights: load pretrained weights into a Phi4MMForCausalLM model with prefix mapping and stacked param handling
